facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary complete remission endpoint, not statistically significant · Phase 3 · eprenetapopt plus azacitidine in TP53 mutant MDS · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The trial did not meet the predefined primary endpoint of complete remission (CR) rate.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the CR rate in the eprenetapopt with AZA arm was 33.3% (95% CI: 23.1% - 44.9%) compared to 22.4% (95% CI: 13.6% - 33.4%) in the AZA alone arm (P = 0.13).
evidence.safety: The combination of eprenetapopt with AZA appeared well-tolerated, with an adverse event profile that was similar to the Company’s prior Phase 2 clinical trials.
evidence.program_discontinued: Our other clinical trials continue to progress and we remain committed to pursuing our clinical development programs.
